verdict: Paid channels are inactive; Google Business Profile is your only live channel.
narrative: This period, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads, so there are no paid leads or spend to report. Your Google Business Profile carried all engagement — 60 total actions over the last 28 days, including 36 direction requests, 23 website clicks, and 1 call. That profile activity is now softening: actions fell 12.5% in the most recent week, and the last three days recorded nearly zero activity, which is a confirmed deceleration. Paid campaigns are being prepared to reactivate, which will restore a direct lead-generation channel and reduce reliance on organic profile traffic alone.
